---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div style="margin-bottom:8px;">
  <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter node e.g. GB7FCI"
         style="padding:6px;width:240px;">
</div>

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #ffffff;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

/* ----------------------------
   CANONICAL NODE NAME FIX
---------------------------- */
function canonical(id) {
  if (!id) return id;
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "GB7CAM";
  return id;
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODE COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {
  if (id === "GB7CAM") return "#e74c3c";  // core

  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "#3498db";
  if (id.startsWith("M7") || id.startsWith("2E1")) return "#2ecc71";
  if (id.startsWith("KC2") || id.startsWith("N2") || id.startsWith("ZL")) return "#f1c40f";

  return "#7f8c8d";
}

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ecc71"; // RF
    case "2": return "#f39c12"; // Telnet
    case "3": return "#3498db"; // AXIP
    default:  return "#95a5a6";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH
---------------------------- */
function width(q) {
  if (!q) return 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, q / 45));
}

let nodesDS, edgesDS, fullData, network;

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD
---------------------------- */
async function load() {

  const res = await fetch(API);
  fullData = await res.json();

  const nodeMap = new Map();

  /* ---- NODES (canonicalised) ---- */
  (fullData.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    const id = canonical(n.id);

    nodeMap.set(id, {
      id,
      label: `${id}\n${n.alias || ""}`,
      color: nodeColor(id)
    });
  });

  /* ---- EDGES (canonicalised) ---- */
  const edges = (fullData.edges || []).map((e, i) => {

    const source = canonical(e.source);
    const target = canonical(e.target);

    return {
      id: i,
      from: source,
      to: target,

      arrows: "to",
      width: width(e.quality),

      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",

      color: {
        color: portColor(e.port),
        highlight: "#2c3e50"
      },

      dashes: e.quality === 0,

      font: {
        color: "#2c3e50",
        size: 10
      },

      shadow: e.state === "Active"
    };
  });

  edgesDS = new vis.DataSet(edges);

  nodesDS = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  network = new vis.Network(
    document.getElementById("network"),
    { nodes: nodesDS, edges: edgesDS },
    {
      physics: {
        stabilization: true,
        barnesHut: {
          gravitationalConstant: -8000,
          springLength: 130
        }
      },

      nodes: {
        shape: "dot",
        size: 14,
        font: { color: "#2c3e50" },
        borderWidth: 1
      },

      edges: {
        smooth: { type: "dynamic" }
      }
    }
  );
}

/* ----------------------------
   SIMPLE FILTER (no UI modes)
---------------------------- */
function applyFilter() {

  const f = document.getElementById("filter").value.toUpperCase();

  nodesDS.forEach(n => {
    const show =
      !f ||
      n.id.includes(f) ||
      (n.label || "").toUpperCase().includes(f);

    nodesDS.update({
      id: n.id,
      hidden: !show
    });
  });

  edgesDS.forEach(e => {
    const fromNode = nodesDS.get(e.from);
    const toNode = nodesDS.get(e.to);

    edgesDS.update({
      id: e.id,
      hidden: !(fromNode && !fromNode.hidden && toNode && !toNode.hidden)
    });
  });
}

load();

document.getElementById("filter").addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
</script>
